title: Leyla's wedding and the old traditions (paraphrase)
topic: A family argues about tradition and gender roles before a wedding: Leyla keeps her surname, her father and grandfather defend the old roles, her fiancé cooks, her sister and finally her grandmother take her side
tail_E: At the ceremony, Leyla wears a long white
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'dress' is the natural continuation of 'Leyla wears a long white' in a wedding context; the word and its German equivalents (Kleid / Brautkleid) occur nowhere in the units or the tail. ' dress' is a single Pythia token (id 7619).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (F15B, wedding and gender roles, Leyla, paraphrase)
notes: Formulation B, domain culture_values: independent re-phrasing of the ten meaning units of F15A in both languages (same events, same order, same names Leyla and Emre). 'Surname' becomes 'family name' / 'Familienname', the father 'objects' ('widerspricht', inseparable 'wider-'), the aunts 'quarrel' ('zanken sich'), the grandfather 'justifies' the old roles 'at great length', the grandmother 'respects' Leyla's wish 'after all' / 'schließlich doch'. Unit 10 has the coordinated subject 'Bride and groom' / 'Braut und Bräutigam' (plural agreement) with a bare intransitive predicate. No separable verbs ('zubereiten', 'zustimmen', 'beistehen' avoided). Unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
